title: Correct stablecoin context snapshot missingness
instructions: In build_stablecoin_context(), selecting the latest row separately for each metric mixes snapshots: a later USDT supply-only snapshot inherits older price/change. Anchor each component on its newest PIT-visible supply row, then use only metrics with matching asset, source, effective/available/observed clocks, revision, and stablecoin_id when present. Missing snapshot metrics must remain None and reduce coverage; do not forward-fill. Preserve PIT, raw/audit provenance, context-only status, and frozen scoring. Add test_stablecoin_context_snapshot_coherence_v2: parse two separate same-day DefiLlama payloads, each containing exactly one USDT entry (id 2). Earlier observed 1787520000000: supply 1000, prevDay 950, price 1.001. Later observed 1787520500000: supply 1200, no prevDay or price. At earlier as_of assert supply=1000, price=1.001, change_1d=50. At later as_of assert supply=1200, price/change_1d/peg deviation=None, missing_fields includes price and change_1d, peg_price_coverage and change_coverage['1d'] both zero, weighted peg deviation and tracked_change_1d=None. Never put duplicate same-symbol entries in one payload: the parser keeps the last, which caused the previous task's invalid test failure. Keep existing tests passing.
